## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Āpídámó Jùshě Lùn Běn Sòng* 阿毘達磨俱舍論本頌 (Skt. *Abhidharmakośa-kārikā*, "Root Verses of the Abhidharmakośa"; CBETA T29n1560) is a Tang dynasty extraction of the verse (*kārikā*) portion of Vasubandhu's *Abhidharmakośa-bhāṣya*, 1 juan, by [世親菩薩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%96%E8%A6%AA%E8%8F%A9%E8%96%A9) and translated by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98). The source text header reads "世親菩薩造 / 三藏法師玄奘奉詔譯" with the subtitle "(說一切有部)" identifying the Sarvāstivāda school. The Taisho cross-reference reads "No. 1560 [cf. Nos. 1558, 1559, 1561]."

**Abstract**

The *Kośa-kārikā* consists of the approximately 600 root verses (*kārikā*) of the *Abhidharmakośa* ([KR6l0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0023), T1558), extracted from Xuanzang's full translation and presented without the accompanying prose auto-commentary (*bhāṣya*). This format served practical needs: students could memorize the verses, and commentators could use them as a base-text. The verse text follows the same eight-pāda structure as the full work (分別界品 through 分別定品), plus the 破我品 verses.

This kārikā-text is the base text on which 圓暉 [圓暉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%9A%89) composed his *Jùshě lùn sòng shū* ([KR6l0036](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0036), T1823), which became the dominant East Asian commentary on the verses.
